results.title: Review: How the Other Half Loves at Old Vic
results.description: Oh, what a tangled web we weave... Alan Ayckbourn’s almost 60-year-old How the Other Half Loves is still unsurprisingly modern, unsurprising because it’s about toxic masculinity overwhelming the female partners in relationships, writes Michael Holland. But it is still unsurprisingly funny, although now it feels quite wrong to think so. Written in the early days
